## Summary

## Safety and context impact

- [ ] No credential/private data is included.
- [ ] Tool outputs are bounded and serializable.
- [ ] Write annotations/policy/approval behavior is covered by tests, or not applicable.
- [ ] Explicit context does not persist a context switch.

## Validation

- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make build`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and compatibility docs updated when applicable.
